research_question: Does previous-bucket aggressive-volume imbalance improve next-bucket trade-price prediction, and what happens when that frozen forecast shifts a dealer quote?
scope: Exploratory educational research with a prospective held-out evaluation within this project; not a registered study or an executable historical backtest.
prior_exposure: September 1-3 minute summaries and September 1 individual-trade responses were already inspected. They are development data. September 4-8 have not been downloaded or inspected for this project at plan creation.
feature: Signed ETH volume imbalance over [t-5s,t): (aggressive buy volume - aggressive sell volume) / total volume.
reference: Last traded price strictly before t; not an observed midquote.
target: 10000 * (last traded price in [t,t+5s) / reference - 1). Only adjacent nonempty buckets, within the same UTC day. Missing buckets are not forward filled.
model: OLS with intercept and imbalance, fitted only on training dates. Predictive signal clipped to +/-2bp. No validation-driven model or hyperparameter selection.
forecast_metrics: directional accuracy excluding zero actual returns
primary_policy_comparison: flow minus inventory, paired by date and willingness seed; also flow minus intercept_only to isolate the imbalance slope. Constant_wide is an inventory-aware participation/width control.

replay.normalization: Each day's first eligible reference price becomes 100. Quantities are single normalized units; P&L is model currency, not USDT or realized returns.
replay.execution_assumption: One hypothetical customer per eligible following bucket. Side comes from that bucket's first observed aggressor; its willingness distance is an independent exponential draw with stated mean. This is a synthetic limit, not an observed limit or evidence of an actual fill. Same pre-generated environment for all policies.
replay.policy_information: Only current reference, previous-bucket imbalance, inventory and frozen model; no next price, future side or customer limit.
replay.quote_clamp: Total center shift clipped to +/-(half spread minus one tick), so quotes straddle the reference. Execution edge is nonnegative by construction.
replay.gaps: No customer opportunity across missing buckets; carry inventory and mark it from the previous observed next reference to the next eligible current reference. Include this gap revaluation in total P&L. Liquidate at the last eligible observed next reference, not necessarily UTC midnight.

decision_rule: Report forecast improvement or deterioration versus BOTH constant baselines and paired flow-policy effects, even if negative or conflicting. Do not select a winner from test results or claim real profitability. No further tuning in this iteration.
inference_limits: Only three test days, temporally dependent outcomes and overlapping market conditions. Seeds vary hypothetical willingness on the same path, not independent markets. Report per-day results and no significance or seed-based confidence interval.
freeze_rule: Publish this plan before fetching validation/test dates. After development, freeze model, plan, all computational source hashes and development data manifests. Test stage must verify freeze before any test download. Any later correction must be logged and the same test remains previously inspected.
next_iteration: A new hypothesis requires a new dated plan and new unseen dates; do not relabel these test dates as untouched. Order-book/queue data and an execution model remain necessary for actual fill validation.
